summary: Comprehensive architectural and implementation plan for completing the Inventory Management module under the existing Nexora menu structure. Details the 9 integrated sub-pages (Dashboard, Items Master, Categories & Units, Warehouses & Locations, Stock Operations, Movement Ledger, Low-Stock Alerts with conditional Reorder popup, Reorder Management Ledger with supplier negotiation review, and Valuation Reports with Excel Import/Export), RBAC enforcement, PostgreSQL persistence, and zero-pill enterprise UI design.
